summary: A woman in a group of seven descending Horn Peak's northeast ridge glissaded first into a snow-filled gully and triggered a wet avalanche (R1-D2) that carried her ~1,000 ft; partially buried with her head above the snow. Custer County SAR paged ~2:45 pm Saturday; she suffered numerous injuries and was extracted by a Buckley AFB Blackhawk at 12:10 am Sunday to a local hospital. Custer, Fremont, and El Paso County SAR, Flight for Life, and the Colorado Army National Guard assisted.
location: Snow-filled gully, Horn Peak northeast ridge, Sangre de Cristo Mountains
responding_agency: Custer County SAR, Fremont County SAR, El Paso County SAR, Flight for Life, Colorado Army National Guard (Blackhawk)
